actual:
ICP for SKYCOT: any company trying to use AI to automate work.

Target industries: SaaS, ecommerce, agencies, healthcare, logistics, finance, education, and real estate. Target users are founders, marketers, engineers, support teams, sales teams, and operations managers.

Main message: SKYCOT helps your team use AI better and save time. The product should be positioned as an all-in-one AI employee platform.

Reasoning: AI is popular across every business function, so the ICP should stay broad until data shows which segment converts best.

Subject: Save 20 hours a week with SKYCOT

Hi {{first_name}},

SKYCOT is an AI employee platform that can automate sales, support, engineering, marketing, operations, finance, and admin for {{company}}.

Our AI agents learn over time and can replace repetitive work across your whole business. Companies using AI automation are moving faster and cutting costs.

Do you want to see a demo this week?

Thanks,
{{sender}}

The campaign did well because people opened the emails. Open rate was high, so the subject line is working. Reply rate was okay but could be better.

I recommend sending more emails to a larger audience and trying more subject lines. The product seems interesting to the market. We should also post on LinkedIn and maybe run ads.

Next step: scale the campaign to 5,000 contacts and offer a discount for early users.
